item.dc:creator: Dominic-Madori Davis

item.title: In ‘You Can See Everything,’ Elizabeth Holmes meets her equal in comedian Nathan Fielder
item.dc:creator: Amanda Silberling
item.description: Nathan Fielder's documentary about disgraced Theranos CEO Elizabeth Holmes has created a constellation of colliding personas that interrogate the very nature of authenticity.

item.title: Jev is Vercel’s fastest-adopted AI model ever
item.dc:creator: Russell Brandom
item.description: The data comes from Vercel's AI gateway, a unified API service similar to OpenRouter.

item.title: Mark Wahlberg on using AI in film ‘the right way’ and being open to an AI clone carrying on his legacy
item.dc:creator: Aisha Malik
item.description: Actor and angel investor Mark Wahlberg says he's OK with using AI in filmmaking, provided it's used "to enhance what you're doing."

item.title: Veritas expands its anti-counterfeit chip to jewelry, trophies, and fragrance bottles
item.dc:creator: Ivan Mehta
item.description: Counterfeiters are getting better at replicating brands' marks and passing off dupes, known as "superfakes," as genuine items. A startup called Veritas wants to tackle the problem with its own chip that verifies goods.

item.title: Replit’s CEO says the future of work is the ‘self-driving company’
item.dc:creator: Sarah Perez
item.description: Replit CEO Amjad Masad envisions a future of “self-driving companies,” where AI agents handle day-to-day tasks and people focus on higher-level decisions.

item.title: Even Benchmark thinks AI is eroding the venture pact against backing rivals
item.dc:creator: Connie Loizos
item.description: Benchmark says the Valley’s rule against backing rivals is getting harder to keep.

item.title: Tesla reveals SpaceX-powered Roadster that flies and falls with style
item.dc:creator: Sean O'Kane
item.description: The new car used thrusters to leap over a Cybercab, Cybertruck, Tesla Semi, Model Y, and Model 3 at a demo in Texas.

item.title: When it came to Cal AI’s viral success, a small army of influencers paid off
item.dc:creator: Lucas Ropek
item.description: The company generated over $30 million in revenue in two years and was acquired by MyFitnessPal for an undisclosed amount of money in March.

item.title: And the winner of Startup Battlefield at Disrupt 2026 is: Intero Biosystems
item.dc:creator: Sean O'Kane
item.description: Intero Biosystems beat out 199 other Startup Battlefield companies to take home the $100,000 grand prize at TechCrunch Disrupt 2026.

item.title: Amazon devices chief Panos Panay on the importance of failure and bouncing back from it
item.dc:creator: Aisha Malik
item.description: Panay said that it's possible to recover and learn from all sorts of failures, even catastrophic ones, when building products.

item.title: Meta launches an open-weight AI model that runs on Macs
item.dc:creator: Lucas Ropek
item.description: Meta and Apple have teamed up for the launch of the social media giant's newest model, Muse Spark Open, which will run locally on Apple silicon.

item.title: Amazon devices chief Panos Panay sees a future where AI devices replace the need to use apps
item.dc:creator: Sarah Perez
item.description: Speaking at TechCrunch Disrupt, Amazon devices chief Panos Panay described a future where ambient AI devices work in the background, anticipating users' needs instead of waiting for commands.

item.title: Bluesky wants to make it easier to buy, sell, and fundraise on the network
item.dc:creator: Aisha Malik
item.description: The executives argued that advertising isn’t the only path to monetization, and that there are alternative models that are feasible when it comes to monetization.

item.title: Anthropic is letting METR researchers look under the hood with employee-level access
item.dc:creator: Aditya Mehta
item.description: METR will publish its own assessments of Anthropic’s risks, incidents, and practices, and the frontier AI model maker has given up the right to block them.

item.title: Bluesky expands its AI-powered Attie app to let anyone build websites, games, and more
item.dc:creator: Sarah Perez
item.description: Bluesky is bringing “social vibe coding” to its experimental Attie platform, allowing users to create interactive experiences like games, quizzes, and websites that can tap into the social network's audience.

item.title: Last chance to save up to $200 on your TechCrunch Founder Summit pass: Early booking ends October 16
item.dc:creator: TechCrunch Events
item.description: Savings of up to $200 end October 16 for TechCrunch Founder Summit. These savings for Founder and Investor Passes vanish after Friday. Join 1,000 founders and investors on November 4 at Boston’s SoWa Power Station. Bring your toughest questions and make the day count for your business.

item.title: Volvo makes a bigger bet on Nvidia for hands-free automated driving
item.dc:creator: Kirsten Korosec
item.description: Volvo is leveling up its automated driving system through an expansion of its nearly decade-long partnership with Nvidia that will extend beyond its battery electric vehicles.

item.title: SK Hynix bargains for chip equipment exports to its China facility in return for building a factory in US
item.dc:creator: Kate Park
item.description: SK Hynix’s Solidigm is reportedly seeking U.S. approval to send more chipmaking equipment to China as it weighs building a new NAND chip factory in America.
